headline: Visa (V) Just Completed Greater China’s First AI Powered B2B Agentic Payment
summary: Visa (NYSE:V) and Lianlian completed Greater China's first AI powered B2B agentic payment. The transaction used Visa's Agentic Directory to run an end to end cross border payment autonomously within preset controls. The move highlights Visa's push into agentic commerce and machine to machine financial transactions. For investors tracking Visa at a share price of $355.74, this AI powered B2B payment with Lianlian puts fresh attention on the company's role in digital payment infrastructure...
